run_launch_vertex_ai: run the launch_vertex_ai script to launch a consumer-producer program on Vertex AI
create_DockerConfig: create an xm_docker.DockerConfig with a build directory and requirements file path for launchpad nodes
run_lp_launch: run lp.launch with a program, LaunchType.VERTEX_AI, and xm_resources mapping node names to DockerConfig
create_make_program: create a launchpad program topology with make_program specifying the number of concurrent producers
run_main: run the main function to launch consumer-producer nodes on Google Cloud Vertex AI with configurable producer count
